title: M7b2 production consumer integration smoke and compatibility proof
instructions: Prove that the Quanttrading DuckDB entry can consume query-entry routing without breaking no-pointer behavior. Before modifying C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading/server/db/duckdb-client.mjs, back up the exact original file under the consumer-integration-proof artifact directory and record code-level revert steps. Integrate routing inertly: default openDuckDb behavior must not import or activate query-entry routing when no explicit option/env flag is provided. Routed mode may be enabled only with an explicit option or environment flag and must support an artifact-local pointer smoke for daily_basic/month=2026-05. Run no-pointer smoke against the real C:/Workspace/Quanttrading/Quanttrading/data/quant.duckdb with OPEN_READONLY and prove row/profile equivalence against the pre-change behavior. Run artifact-local pointer smoke proving daily_basic routed reads resolve through the integrated consumer. Record affected consumers and unchanged default path. Do not write metadata/query-entry/daily_basic.json. Do not write data/clean/daily_basic/_current.json. Do not modify target Parquet, clean manifest, or source DuckDB. Do not create T7b3/T7b4/T7c/M8 task files. Finish for Claude review.
summary: T7b2 integrated query-entry routing into duckdb-client.mjs inertly. Exact pre-change duckdb-client.mjs backup was written under consumer-integration-proof. Default no-pointer openDuckDb path remains without queryEntry and pre/post real DuckDB OPEN_READONLY profile+sample are identical. Explicit queryEntry.enabled mode installs dailyBasic helper and artifact-local routed smoke passes: inside pilot window routes to Parquet with 75018 rows; outside-window fallback matches direct source profile; invalid date rejected. Targeted Vitest passed (1 file, 7 tests). Production query-entry pointer and _current remain absent; source DuckDB size/mtime, clean manifest, and target Parquet are unchanged. No T7b3/T7b4/T7c/M8 task files were created.
